text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report outlines the results of an investigation into installing speed humps on Duckworth Street, between Lawrence Avenue West and Thurodale Avenue. The results indicate that the criteria to justify installing speed humps are not satisfied.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Authorized the Director, Transportation Services to request the City Clerk to poll eligible householders in English or any other language specified by Community Council, on Duckworth Street, between Lawrence Avenue West and Thurodale Avenue, to determine if property owners/occupants support the installation, according to the City of Toronto Traffic Calming Policy. 2. Subject to favourable results of the poll: a. Authorized the installation of traffic calming (speed humps) on Duckworth Street, between Lawrence Avenue West and Thurodale Avenue. b. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter sections of the roadway on Duckworth Street for traffic calming enhancement, generally as shown on Drawing EY19-072, dated August 2019 and circulated to residents during the polling process.
